content.scenario: The State Government of Maharashtra recognizes a laboratory, 'SafeFood Lab', which is funded by the government to test food products for safety and quality standards. A consumer complains about a particular brand of packaged food, suspecting it contains harmful additives. The consumer protection authority sends the product to SafeFood Lab for testing.
content.outcome: In this scenario, SafeFood Lab would be considered an appropriate laboratory under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as it is recognized by a State Government and is involved in testing goods (food products) to determine if they suffer from any defect.
